trackInfo.heading: Opening Times
trackInfo.text:
Stadium opening hours:

Monday – Friday: 7:30 am – 9:00 pm
Saturday – Sunday: 9:00 am – 3:00 pm

Last admission is 45 minutes before closing. Hours can change for events and bank holidays, so check with the venue before travelling.

trackInfo.heading: Entry Price
trackInfo.text:
Prices from 1 January 2026:

Adult track session: £7.40
Junior track session: £4.80
Spectator: £2.00 adult, £1.00 junior
Track hire: £82 per hour

trackInfo.heading: Track Details
trackInfo.text:
Length: 400m oval
Floodlights: Yes
Surface: Refurbished synthetic track, reopened in August 2025.
Certification: TrackMark accredited.

trackInfo.heading: Address
trackInfo.text: Costello Stadium, Anlaby Park Road North, Hull, HU4 6XQ
